tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event at an ISO 8601 time with an explicit UTC offset. This does not send invitations.

tools.name: send_invitation
tools.description: Send one invitation for an existing calendar event to one email address. Each call sends a separate invitation.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Read an existing calendar event without modifying it or sending invitations.
